recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s pop-style composition featuring a central photographic subject standing atop a steam locomotive, surrounded by bold, multi-colored sans-serif typography on a clean white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into large-scale display typography
Dynamic perspective of the train leading from bottom-center to right-middle
Triadic color scheme of orange-red, magenta, and blue against stark white
Scale contrast between massive locomotive and human figure
coreInvariants: Sharp photographic cutouts with no soft edges
Italicized header text with motion-blur graphic devices

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A woman stands atop a steam engine centered in the lower half; the engine recedes into the distance at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue display name spanning the horizontal center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left italicized text, drops to the large blue name, follows the woman down to the train, and finishes at the red list on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space at the top and sides to emphasize the graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Magenta and Orange-Red (Secondary Type and Clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a high-value white background for maximum pop-art impact.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Repeated 'L' characters at the top left with a staggered, motion-blur effect in orange-red

composition.relationshipToImage: Subject stands in front of and between words

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and slants of the same sans-serif family, differentiated by color.
graphicDevices: Staggered repetition of the first letter to imply speed

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the display type.
Provides the necessary mid-century grotesque feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A clean white studio background. In the lower center, a vintage black steam locomotive is positioned at a slight angle receding into the distance. A woman in 1960s attire (orange patterned shirt, blue pants) stands confidently on top of the train's boiler. High contrast, sharp edges, pop-art style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large condensed blue sans-serif text across the middle. Add a magenta italicized header at the top with a staggered orange repetition of the first letter on the left. Add a list of red condensed sans-serif text in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Are the colors vibrant and flat?
Is the typography condensed and sans-serif?
Does the train have a clear perspective line?

adjustableVariables: Number of repeated letters in the motion effect
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Check that the motion-blur effect on the first letter is distinct
Verify the red text list is left-aligned and legible
Confirm the blue text appears to be 'behind' the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vintage Machine] + [Human Subject on top] + [Large Condensed Sans-Serif Overlay] + [Triadic Color Palette] + [White Negative Space].
